notes: The assignment named 'the PRACE successor' as an open item. The answer is that the successor is not a separate brand: it is the EuroHPC JU, which absorbed PRACE's peer-review process at the end of 2022. A reconciler should treat PRACE as resolved into the EuroHPC rows and not open a PRACE record in the dossier. No quota is recorded because there is no live call. Identity cost is recorded as 'none' rather than a normal vocabulary value, because a withdrawn programme has no applicant and no identity to produce; recording 'institution' here would imply a door that no longer exists.
